field.name: BoardDownMessage 'items' variant
field.type: { readonly type: 'items'; readonly items: readonly { readonly itemId: string; readonly kind: 'epic' | 'story' | 'task' | 'issue'; readonly title: string | null; readonly stageLabel: string | null }[] }
field.purpose: Lets s1 list every readable item (title, kind, stage label) before s2's BoardViewModel exists; s2 stops sending it once 'board' is posted.

rationale: The HLD has s1 render a minimal list of item titles until s2 supplies columns, but sc3's down-messages have no variant that carries a list without s2's BoardViewModel. An additive 'items' variant lets s1 show every readable item (s1 ac1, ac3) without defining s2's model. Filed by hand: the LLD's s4 proposal used a string where the store expects a FieldSpec, so the runner dropped it.
